tasks.title: Add rowversion concurrency token to Quote
tasks.instructions: Add a rowversion column to Quotes via a migration and map it as the EF Core concurrency token on the Quote entity. Stale writes must raise DbUpdateConcurrencyException.

tasks.title: Pricing API retries a rejected quote write from a fresh read
tasks.instructions: On DbUpdateConcurrencyException, re-read the quote and reapply the change. Do not swallow the exception after the retry budget.

tasks.title: Referral Worker retries a rejected quote write from a fresh read
tasks.instructions: Same retry behaviour as the Pricing API, in the referral update path.

tasks.title: Log eCommitted on every successful quote write
tasks.instructions: Emit the eCommitted event (logging contract) with the committed value after each successful write, in the format PObserve expects.
